clips.title: The story
paras: In the Undercity, Bethor Iceshard commands the Magic Quarter's arcane and shadow practitioners. He holds authority in Sylvanas's realm, while old friendships still shape his past.

Bethor Iceshard directs arcane and shadow practitioners from the Temple of the Damned in the Undercity. His intellect and icy resolve earn both respect and fear. He has the political and magical weight to instruct provincial magistrates across Lordaeron. Bethor sends Forsaken agents to secure valuable grimoires, investigate arcane anomalies, and suppress rival powers that threaten the Undercity's dominion.
